flashcards.exampleZh: 他会用钢琴弹奏《生日快乐》。

flashcards.definition: A stringed musical instrument, of European origin, usually with a fretted fingerboard and six strings, played with the fingers or a plectrum (guitar pick).
flashcards.example: This is the word GUITAR.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种起源于欧洲的弦乐器，通常带有按动的指板和六根弦，用手指或拨片（吉他拨片）演奏。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是吉他这个词。

flashcards.definition: (general) A sport played on foot in which teams attempt to get a ball into a goal or zone defended by the other team.
flashcards.example: Roman and medieval football matches were more violent than any modern type of football.
flashcards.definitionZh: （一般）一项徒步运动，球队试图将球带入另一队防守的球门或区域。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马和中世纪的足球比赛比任何现代足球比赛都更加暴力。

flashcards.definition: A sport played by two players (or four in doubles), who alternately strike the ball over a net using racquets.
flashcards.example: This is the word TENNIS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由两名球员（或双打四名球员）进行的一项运动，他们交替使用球拍将球击过网。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是网球这个词。

flashcards.definition: The part of the day from dawn to noon.
flashcards.example: I'll see you tomorrow morning.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一天中从黎明到中午的部分时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明天早上见。

flashcards.definition: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime until sunset, evening, or suppertime or 6pm.
flashcards.example: This is the word AFTERNOON.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一天中从中午或午餐时间到日落、晚上、晚餐时间或下午 6 点的这段时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“下午”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A concluding time period; a point in time near the end of something; the beginning of the end of something.
flashcards.example: It was the evening of the Roman Empire.
flashcards.definitionZh: 结束时间段；某事接近结束的时间点；某事结束的开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那是罗马帝国的黄昏。

flashcards.definition: The period between sunset and sunrise, when a location faces far away from the sun, thus when the sky is dark.
flashcards.example: How do you sleep at night when you attack your kids like that!?
flashcards.definitionZh: 日落和日出之间的时期，此时某个地点远离太阳，因此天空是黑暗的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当你这样攻击你的孩子时，你晚上怎么睡觉！？

flashcards.definition: A piece of furniture, usually flat and soft, on which to rest or sleep.
flashcards.example:
My cat often sleeps on my bed.
I keep a glass of water next to my bed when I sleep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一件家具，通常平坦且柔软，可供休息或睡觉。
flashcards.exampleZh:
我的猫经常睡在我的床上。
睡觉时我会在床边放一杯水。

flashcards.definition: A turn at something, or in something (e.g. a game).
flashcards.example: It’s your go.
flashcards.definitionZh: 转向某事或某事（例如游戏）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是你的。

flashcards.definition: Each of the two, or of the two kinds.
flashcards.example: "Did you want this one or that one?" — "Give me both."
flashcards.definitionZh: 两者中的每一种，或两种中的一种。
flashcards.exampleZh: “你想要这个还是那个？” ——“都给我。”

flashcards.definition: (after a negative) As well.
flashcards.example: I don't like him, and I don't like her either.
flashcards.definitionZh: （在否定之后）也是如此。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不喜欢他，也不喜欢她。

flashcards.definition: A part of a larger whole, usually in such a form that it is able to be separated from other parts.
flashcards.example: I’d like another piece of pie.
flashcards.definitionZh: 较大整体的一部分，通常以能够与其他部分分离的形式存在。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我想要另一块馅饼。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“一天”这个词。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: A historically constituted, stable community of people, formed on the basis of a common language, territory, economic life, ethnicity and/or psychological make-up manifested in a common culture.
flashcards.example: The Kurdish people constitute a nation in the Middle East
flashcards.definitionZh: 在历史上形成的、稳定的人民共同体，在共同语言、领土、经济生活、种族和/或共同文化所体现的心理素质的基础上形成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 库尔德人在中东构成一个民族

flashcards.definition: Membership of a particular nation or state, by origin, birth, naturalization, ownership, allegiance or otherwise.
flashcards.example: This is the word NATIONALITY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 根据出身、出生、入籍、所有权、效忠或其他原因成为特定民族或国家的成员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“国籍”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word british.
flashcards.example: This is the word british.
flashcards.definitionZh: 英国这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是英国这个词。

flashcards.definition: To be alive; to have life.
flashcards.example: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.
flashcards.definitionZh: 活着；拥有生命。
flashcards.exampleZh: 预计他的寿命不会超过几个月。

flashcards.definition: Giving pleasure; pleasing in manner.
flashcards.example: It wasn't so hot outside, but pleasant enough to have lunch in the garden.
flashcards.definitionZh: 给予快乐；令人愉快的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 外面不太热，但在花园里吃午饭还是很舒服的。

flashcards.definition: Not pleasant.
flashcards.example: This is the word UNPLEASANT PLEASANT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不愉快。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“不愉快”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Matter in a state intermediate between liquid and plasma that can be contained only if it is fully surrounded by a solid (or in a bubble of liquid) (or held together by gravitational pull); it can condense into a liquid, or can (rarely) become a solid directly.
flashcards.example: A lot of gas had escaped from the cylinder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 处于液体和等离子体之间的中间状态的物质，只有在完全被固体包围（或在液体气泡中）（或通过引力保持在一起）时才能被容纳；它可以凝结成液体，或者可以（很少）直接变成固体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 大量气体从气瓶中逸出。

flashcards.definition: To apply fibreglass to.
flashcards.example: to fibreglass the hull of a fishing-boat
flashcards.definitionZh: 应用玻璃纤维。
flashcards.exampleZh: 渔船的玻璃纤维船体

flashcards.definition: A concave vessel for drinking from, usually made of opaque material (as opposed to a glass) and with a handle.
flashcards.example: Pour the tea into the cup.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于饮用的凹形容器，通常由不透明材料（而不是玻璃）制成并带有手柄。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将茶倒入杯中。

flashcards.definition: Having much distance from one terminating point on an object or an area to another terminating point (usually applies to horizontal dimensions; see Usage Notes below).
flashcards.example: It's a long way from the Earth to the Moon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从对象或区域上的一个终止点到另一终止点的距离很远（通常适用于水平尺寸；请参阅下面的使用说明）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从地球到月球有很长的距离。

flashcards.definition: Having little duration.
flashcards.example: Our meeting was a short six minutes today. Every day for the past month it’s been at least twenty minutes long.
flashcards.definitionZh: 持续时间短。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天我们的会议只有短短的六分钟。过去一个月的每一天都至少有二十分钟长。

flashcards.definition: Very elevated; extending or being far above a base; tall; lofty.
flashcards.example: The balloon rose high in the sky.   The wall was high.   a high mountain
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常高；延伸或远高于底座；高的;崇高的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 气球升到了高高的天空。   墙很高。   一座高山

flashcards.definition: Situated close to, or even below, the ground or another normal reference plane; not high or lofty.
flashcards.example: a low wall  a low shelf
flashcards.definitionZh: 位于地面或其他法线参考平面附近甚至下方；不高也不崇高。
flashcards.exampleZh: 矮墙 矮架子

flashcards.definition: Of considerable or relatively great size or extent.
flashcards.example: Russia is a large country.   The fruit-fly has large eyes for its body size.   He has a large collection of stamps.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有相当大或相对较大的规模或范围。
flashcards.exampleZh: 俄罗斯是一个大国。   相对于其体型而言，果蝇的眼睛很大。   他收藏了大量邮票。

flashcards.definition: Not large or big; insignificant; few in number.
flashcards.example: A small group.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不大不小；微不足道;数量很少。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一个小团体。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: A large and often winding stream which drains a land mass, carrying water down from higher areas to a lower point, oftentimes ending in another body of water, such as an ocean or in an inland sea.
flashcards.example: Occasionally rivers overflow their banks and cause floods.
flashcards.definitionZh: 排干陆地的大型且通常蜿蜒的河流，将水从较高的地区带到较低的地区，通常最终流入另一个水体，例如海洋或内海。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有时河流会溢出堤岸并引发洪水。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word nile.
flashcards.example: This is the word nile.
flashcards.definitionZh: 尼罗河这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是尼罗河这个词。

flashcards.definition: (with "the") Human collective existence; existence in general.
flashcards.example: There will always be lovers, till the world’s end.
flashcards.definitionZh: （与“the”）人类集体存在；普遍存在。
flashcards.exampleZh: 总会有恋人的，直到世界的尽头。

flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: An elevation of land of considerable dimensions rising more or less abruptly, forming a conspicuous figure in the landscape, usually having a small extent of surface at its summit.
flashcards.example: We spent the weekend hiking in the mountains.
flashcards.definitionZh: 相当大的土地的高地或多或少地突然上升，在景观中形成一个显着的图形，通常在其顶部有一小部分表面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们周末在山里徒步旅行。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word everest.
flashcards.example: This is the word everest.
flashcards.definitionZh: 珠穆朗玛峰这个词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是珠穆朗玛峰这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any of seven fleshy prominences in the palm of the hand, taken to represent the influences of various heavenly bodies.
flashcards.example: the mount of Jupiter
flashcards.definitionZh: 手掌上的七个肉质突起中的任何一个，代表各种天体的影响。
flashcards.exampleZh: 木星山

flashcards.example: This is the word tokyo.
flashcards.definitionZh: 东京这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是东京这个词。

flashcards.definition: The fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera, somewhat in the shape of an olive, containing a soft, sweet pulp and enclosing a hard kernel.
flashcards.example: We made a nice cake from dates.
flashcards.definitionZh: 枣椰树（Phoenix dactylifera）的果实，有点像橄榄的形状，含有柔软、甜的果肉，并包裹着坚硬的果仁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们用枣做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

flashcards.definition: Visible electromagnetic radiation. The human eye can typically detect radiation (light) in the wavelength range of about 400 to 750 nanometers. Nearby shorter and longer wavelength ranges, although not visible, are commonly called ultraviolet and infrared light.
flashcards.example: As you can see, this spacious dining-room gets a lot of light in the mornings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可见电磁辐射。人眼通常可以检测到波长范围约为 400 至 750 纳米的辐射（光）。附近较短和较长的波长范围虽然不可见，但通常称为紫外线和红外线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 正如您所看到的，这间宽敞的餐厅在早晨光线充足。

flashcards.definition: A villain or bad guy; the one responsible for evil or aggressive acts.
flashcards.example: With his wrinkled, uneven face, the actor always seemed to play the heavy in films.
flashcards.definitionZh: 恶棍或坏人；对邪恶或侵略行为负责的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这位演员脸上布满皱纹，凹凸不平，看起来总是在电影中扮演沉重的角色。

flashcards.definition: An act of shopping, especially routine shopping for food and other domestic supplies.
flashcards.example: This is where I do my weekly shop.
flashcards.definitionZh: 购物行为，尤其是购买食品和其他家庭用品的常规购物行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是我每周购物的地方。

flashcards.definition: A solid or hollow sphere, or roughly spherical mass.
flashcards.example: a ball of spittle; a fecal ball
flashcards.definitionZh: 实心或空心球体，或大致球形的物体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一团唾沫；一个粪球

flashcards.definition: A room in a house where a bed is kept for sleeping.
flashcards.example: Please don't enter my bedroom without knocking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 房子里的一个房间，里面有一张床供睡觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请不要在不敲门的情况下进入我的卧室。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To obtain; to acquire.

flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）获得；获取。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我明天要去折扣店买一台电脑。

flashcards.definitionZh: 在意识减弱的状态下休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你每天应该睡8小时。

flashcards.definition: For one; apiece; per.
flashcards.example: The apples cost 50 cents each.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对于一个；一块;每。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些苹果每个售价 50 美分。

flashcards.definition: Any plant.
flashcards.example: This is the word VEGETABLE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是蔬菜这个词。

flashcards.definition: The tuber of a plant, Solanum tuberosum, eaten as a starchy vegetable, particularly in the Americas and Europe; this plant.
flashcards.example: This is the word POTATO.

flashcards.exampleZh: 这是土豆这个词。

flashcards.example: This is the word CARROT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 胡萝卜 (Daucus carota) 是一种具有营养丰富、多汁、甜根的蔬菜，通常呈橙色，特别是伞形科的胡萝卜亚种。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是胡萝卜这个词。

flashcards.example: This is the word ONION.

flashcards.definitionZh: 最终结果、影响或结果；有利或不利的结果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当他的业务蓬勃发展并获得加薪时，他在办公室的漫漫长夜最终有了成果。

flashcards.example: This is the word APPLE.

flashcards.definitionZh: 不满意；不满意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不满意的顾客不太可能回到您的商店。

flashcards.definition: An entity, usually animate, deemed superior to another; one who has a claim to precedence; a superior.
flashcards.example: He quickly found Ali his better in the ring.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个实体，通常是有生命的，被认为优于另一个实体；拥有优先权的人；一个上级。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他很快发现阿里在擂台上表现更好。

flashcards.definition: Unfavorable; negative; not good.
flashcards.example: Abducting children is bad for mothers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不利;消极的;不好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 拐卖孩子对母亲来说是不好的。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word look at.
flashcards.example: This is the word look at.
flashcards.definitionZh: 看这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是看这个词。

flashcards.definition: A portable or wearable timepiece.
flashcards.example: More people today carry a watch on their wrists than in their pockets.
flashcards.definitionZh: 便携式或可穿戴计时器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如今，更多的人将手表戴在手腕上，而不是放在口袋里。

flashcards.definition: Something which is bought; a purchase.
flashcards.example: At only $30, the second-hand kitchen table was a great buy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 买来的东西；购买。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这张二手厨房桌子只要 30 美元，非常划算。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) A verbal form that functions as a verbal noun. (In English, a gerund has the same spelling as a present participle, but functions differently; however, this distinction may be ambiguous or unclear and so is no longer made in some modern texts such as A Comprehensive Grammar of the English Language and The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language)
flashcards.example: This is the word GERUND.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）充当动词名词的动词形式。 （在英语中，动名词与现在分词的拼写相同，但功能不同；然而，这种区别可能是含糊或不清楚的，因此在一些现代文本中不再进行区分，例如《英语综合语法》和《剑桥英语语法》）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是动名词这个词。

flashcards.definition: Next to; at the side of.
flashcards.example: A small table beside the bed
flashcards.definitionZh: 旁边;在.的旁边。
flashcards.exampleZh: 床边有一张小桌子

flashcards.definition: Used to emphasize an additional point, especially an important or stronger reason; Moreover; furthermore.
flashcards.example: I don't feel like going out tonight. Besides, I have to work tomorrow morning anyway.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于强调附加的一点，尤其是重要的或更强的理由；而且;此外。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今晚我不想出去。再说了，反正我明天早上还要上班。

flashcards.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.
flashcards.example: To walk briskly for an hour every day is to keep fit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过交替地将每只脚（或一对或一组脚，如果是有四只或更多脚的动物）向前移动，至少一只脚始终踩在地面上。比较跑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每天快走一小时是为了强身健体。

flashcards.definition: To even the slightest extent, at all.
flashcards.example: I will not remain here any longer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 即使是最轻微的程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我不会再留在这里了。

flashcards.definition: True, real, actual.
flashcards.example: He tried his very best.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真实、真实、实在。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他尽了最大努力。

flashcards.definition: An additional one of the same kind.
flashcards.example: There is one sterling and here is another
flashcards.definitionZh: 另一件同类型的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里有一枚英镑，这是另一枚

flashcards.definition: A Christian house of worship; a building where Christian religious services take place.
flashcards.example: There is a lovely little church in the valley.
flashcards.definitionZh: 基督教礼拜堂；举行基督教宗教仪式的建筑。
flashcards.exampleZh: 山谷里有一座可爱的小教堂。

flashcards.definition: Any place seen as an important centre for some activity.
flashcards.example: a temple of commerce, a temple of drinking and dining
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何被视为某些活动的重要中心的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 商业圣殿、饮食圣殿

flashcards.definition: A place of worship for Muslims, often having at least one minaret; a masjid.
flashcards.example: There's a mosque near where I live.
flashcards.definitionZh: 穆斯林礼拜的场所，通常至少有一个尖塔；一座清真寺。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我住的地方附近有一座清真寺。

flashcards.definition: A place of worship for Jews.
flashcards.example: This is the word SYNAGOGUE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 犹太人的礼拜场所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“犹太教堂”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To go or come into an enclosed or partially enclosed space.
flashcards.example: You should knock before you enter, unless you want to see me naked.
flashcards.definitionZh: 进入或进入封闭或部分封闭的空间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 进去之前应该先敲门，除非你想看我裸体。

flashcards.definition: The substance constituting earth's atmosphere, particularly:
flashcards.example: I'm going outside to get some air.
flashcards.definitionZh: 构成地球大气层的物质，特别是：
flashcards.exampleZh: 我要去外面透透气。

flashcards.definition: Area or situation which screens a person or thing from view.
flashcards.example: The soldiers took cover behind a ruined building.
flashcards.definitionZh: 遮蔽人或事物的区域或情况。
flashcards.exampleZh: 士兵们躲在一栋废墟后面。

flashcards.definition: A snowfall; a blanket of frozen, crystalline water.
flashcards.example: We have had several heavy snows this year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场降雪；一层冰冻的结晶水。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今年我们下了几场大雪。

flashcards.definition: Unpleasant or destructive atmospheric conditions, and their effects.
flashcards.example: Wooden garden furniture must be well oiled as it is continuously exposed to weather.
flashcards.definitionZh: 令人不快或具有破坏​​性的大气条件及其影响。
flashcards.exampleZh: 木制花园家具必须充分涂油，因为它不断暴露在天气中。

flashcards.definition: A grasp or grip.
flashcards.example: Keep a firm hold on the handlebars.
flashcards.wordZh: 拿着维持容纳使身体保持某种姿势
flashcards.definitionZh: 抓握或抓握。
flashcards.exampleZh: 牢牢握住车把。

flashcards.definition: Expression and exchange of individual ideas through talking with other people; also, a set instance or occasion of such talking.
flashcards.example: I had an interesting conversation with Nicolas yesterday about how much he's getting paid.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过与他人交谈表达和交流个人想法；此外，此类谈话的特定实例或场合。
flashcards.exampleZh: 昨天我和尼古拉斯就他的薪水进行了一次有趣的对话。

flashcards.definition: A herbal preparation made from one plant, as opposed to something made from more than one plant.
flashcards.example: This is the word SIMPLE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由一种植物制成的草药制剂，而不是由多种植物制成的药物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“简单”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To involve in a convoluted matter.
flashcards.example: Don't complicate yourself in issues that are beyond the scope of your understanding.
flashcards.definitionZh: 卷入复杂的事情。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不要让自己在超出你理解范围的问题上变得复杂化。

flashcards.definition: To perceive the truth or factuality of; to be certain of or that.
flashcards.example: He knew something terrible was going to happen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感知以下事实的真相或事实；确定或那个。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他知道将会发生可怕的事情。

flashcards.definition: Exceptionally good of its kind.
flashcards.example: Bill and Ted had an excellent adventure last week in preparation of their history exam.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在同类产品中非常出色。
flashcards.exampleZh: 比尔和泰德上周在准备历史考试时经历了一次精彩的冒险。

flashcards.definition: An other, another (person, etc), more often rendered as another.
flashcards.example: I'm afraid little Robbie does not always play well with others.
flashcards.definitionZh: 另一个，另一个（人等），更多时候被译为另一个。
flashcards.exampleZh: 恐怕小罗比总是不能和别人相处得很好。

flashcards.definition: Moving with speed, rapidity or swiftness, or capable of doing so; rapid; fast.
flashcards.example: He's a quick runner.
flashcards.definitionZh: 快速、迅速或敏捷地移动，或有能力这样做；迅速的;快速地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他跑得很快。

flashcards.definition: Taking a long time to move or go a short distance, or to perform an action; not quick in motion; proceeding at a low speed.
flashcards.example: a slow train;  a slow computer
flashcards.definitionZh: 花很长时间移动或走一小段距离，或执行一个动作；动作不快；低速前进。
flashcards.exampleZh: 慢速火车；  一台运行缓慢的计算机

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word every.
flashcards.example: This is the word every.
flashcards.definitionZh: 每一个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是每一个词。

flashcards.definition: All people.
flashcards.example: This is the word EVERYBODY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 所有的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是每个人这个词。

flashcards.definition: All the things under discussion.
flashcards.example: I checked the list again and everything is done.
flashcards.definitionZh: 所有的事情都在讨论中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我再次检查了清单，一切都完成了。

flashcards.definition: In or to all locations under discussion.
flashcards.example: He delivers the mail everywhere on this street.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在或前往正在讨论的所有地点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在这条街上到处送邮件。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: Condensed water falling from a cloud.
flashcards.example: The rains came late that year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 凝结的水从云中落下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那年的雨来得很晚。

flashcards.definition: At all times; throughout all time; since the beginning.
flashcards.example: Airplanes did not always exist as a form of transportation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 随时;贯穿所有时间；从一开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 飞机并不总是作为一种交通工具而存在。

flashcards.definition: Respectable; virtuous.
flashcards.example: What is a nice person like you doing in a place like this?
flashcards.definitionZh: 可敬;有道德的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 像你这样的好人在这种地方做什么？

flashcards.definition: The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.
flashcards.example: a book about a time machine that can transport people back into the past
flashcards.definitionZh: 已经发生的时间段，与现在和未来相对照。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一本关于时间机器的书，可以将人们带回到过去

flashcards.definition: (grammar) An inflected form of a verb that indicates tense.
flashcards.example: English only has a present tense and a past tense; it has no future tense.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）表示时态的动词的屈折形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 英语只有现在时和过去时；它没有将来时。

flashcards.definition: The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.
flashcards.example: a book about a time machine that can transport people back into the past
flashcards.definitionZh: 已经发生的时间段，与现在和未来相对照。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一本关于时间机器的书，可以将人们带回到过去

flashcards.definition: Gone; gone by; gone away; passed; passed away.
flashcards.example: in days ago/in days agone
flashcards.definitionZh: 走了；过去了；消失了；通过了；去世了。
flashcards.exampleZh: 几天前/几天前

flashcards.definition: A road; or particularly a car, as a means of transportation.
flashcards.example: We travelled to the seaside by road.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一条路；或者特别是汽车，作为交通工具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们乘公路前往海边。

flashcards.definition: A paved part of road, usually in a village or a town.
flashcards.example: Walk down the street until you see a hotel on the right.
flashcards.definitionZh: 道路的一部分，通常位于村庄或城镇。
flashcards.exampleZh: 沿着街道一直走，直到看到右侧有一家酒店。

flashcards.definition: (of an object) To join (to another object): to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to another object.
flashcards.example: I think this piece connects to that piece over there.
flashcards.definitionZh: （对象的）连接（到另一个对象）：附加到或打算附加到或能够附加到另一个对象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我认为这件作品与那边的那件作品有联系。

flashcards.definition: A path through two or more points (compare ‘segment’); a continuous mark, including as made by a pen; any path, curved or straight.
flashcards.example: The arrow descended in a curved line.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过两个或多个点的路径（比较“线段”）；连续的标记，包括用钢笔做的标记；任何路径，无论是弯的还是直的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 箭矢呈曲线下降。

flashcards.definition: A heterosexual.
flashcards.example: My friends call straights "heteros".
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个异性恋者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的朋友们称异性恋为“异性恋”。

flashcards.definition: To bend, or form into a hook.
flashcards.example: He crooked his finger toward me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 弯曲或形成钩子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他向我弯曲手指。

flashcards.definition: A container, typically made of glass or plastic and having a tapered neck, used primarily for holding liquids.
flashcards.example: Beer is often sold in bottles.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种容器，通常由玻璃或塑料制成，具有锥形颈部，主要用于盛装液体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 啤酒通常以瓶装形式出售。

flashcards.definition: An alcoholic liquor distilled from fermented grain and usually aged in oak barrels.
flashcards.example: This is the word WHISKY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从发酵谷物中蒸馏出来的酒精酒，通常在橡木桶中陈酿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是威士忌这个词。

flashcards.definition: On certain occasions, or in certain circumstances, but not always.
flashcards.example: Sometimes I sit and think, but mostly I just sit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在某些情况下，或在某些情况下，但并非总是如此。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有时我会坐下来思考，但大多数时候我只是坐着。

flashcards.definition: The state and its administration viewed as the ruling political power.
flashcards.example: If the citizens must follow the law, then the government must follow the constitution.
flashcards.definitionZh: 国家及其行政机构被视为执政的政治权力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果公民必须遵守法律，那么政府就必须遵守宪法。

flashcards.definition: The body of binding rules and regulations, customs and standards established in a community by its legislative and judicial authorities.
flashcards.example: entrapment is against the law
flashcards.definitionZh: 由立法和司法当局在社区中制定的具有约束力的规则和条例、习俗和标准的体系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 诱捕是违法的

flashcards.definition: Emotions, kindness, moral effort, or spirit in general.
flashcards.example: The team lost, but they showed a lot of heart.
flashcards.definitionZh: 情感、善良、道德努力或一般精神。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然球队输了，但他们表现出了很大的勇气。

flashcards.definition: Very soon.
flashcards.example: If we go this way, we'll get there quickly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 很快。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果我们沿着这条路走，我们很快就能到达那里。

flashcards.definition: (manner) At a slow pace.
flashcards.example: This is the word SLOWLY.
flashcards.definitionZh: （方式）缓慢地进行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“慢慢地”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) A word that modifies a verb, adjective, other adverbs, or various other types of words, phrases, or clauses.
flashcards.example: I often went outside hiking during my stay in Japan.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）修饰动词、形容词、其他副词或各种其他类型的单词、短语或从句的单词。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在日本期间，我经常出去徒步旅行。

flashcards.definition: One who spends time thinking, contemplating or meditating.
flashcards.example: This is the word THINKER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个花时间思考、沉思或冥想的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“思想者”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work.
flashcards.example: Has your girlfriend written you another letter already? She’s quite a writer!
flashcards.definitionZh: 写作或创作文学作品的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你女朋友已经给你写过另一封信了吗？她真是一位作家！

flashcards.definition: (with "the") The deep part of a lake, sea, etc.
flashcards.example: creatures of the deep
flashcards.definitionZh: （与“the”）湖、海等的深处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 深渊的生物

flashcards.definition: A shallow portion of an otherwise deep body of water.
flashcards.example: The ship ran aground in an unexpected shallow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 较深水体的浅水部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 船在一个意想不到的浅滩搁浅了。

flashcards.definition: Institution of higher education (typically accepting students from the age of about 17 or 18, depending on country, but in some exceptional cases able to take younger students) where subjects are studied and researched in depth and degrees are offered.
flashcards.example: The only reason why I haven't gone to university is because I can't afford it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 高等教育机构（通常接受 17 或 18 岁左右的学生，具体取决于国家/地区，但在某些特殊情况下也可以接受年龄较小的学生），对科目进行深入学习和研究并提供学位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我没有上大学的唯一原因是我负担不起。

flashcards.definition: A cigarette.
flashcards.example: Can I bum a smoke off you?;  I need to go buy some smokes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一支香烟。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我可以给你抽烟吗？  我得去买点烟。

flashcards.definition: To give someone a cigarette, and/or to light one for them.
flashcards.example: Could someone cigarette me?
flashcards.definitionZh: 给某人一支香烟，和/或为他们点燃一根。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有人可以给我抽烟吗？

flashcards.definition: The solid remains of a fire.
flashcards.example: Ash from a fireplace can restore minerals to your garden's soil.
flashcards.definitionZh: 火灾的固体残骸。
flashcards.exampleZh: 壁炉中的灰烬可以恢复花园土壤中的矿物质。

flashcards.definition: A receptacle for ash and butts from cigarettes and cigars.
flashcards.example: This is the word ASHTRAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于存放香烟和雪茄烟灰和烟蒂的容器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是烟灰缸这个词。

flashcards.definition: A delay.
flashcards.example: I had a very long wait at the airport security check.
flashcards.definitionZh: 延迟。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在机场安检处等了很长时间。

flashcards.definition: Always, frequently, forever.
flashcards.example: It was ever thus.
flashcards.definitionZh: 总是、经常、永远。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从来都是这样。

flashcards.definition: At no time; on no occasion; in no circumstance.
flashcards.example: I finally finished, and I never want to do that again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何时候；在任何情况下；在任何情况下。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我终于完成了，我再也不想这样做了。

flashcards.definition: The product of a number or quantity multiplied by itself; the second power of a number, value, term or expression.
flashcards.example: 64 is the square of 8.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数字或数量与其自身相乘的乘积；数字、值、术语或表达式的二次方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 64是8的平方。

flashcards.definition: A two-dimensional geometric figure, a line, consisting of the set of all those points in a plane that are equally distant from a given point (center).
flashcards.example: The set of all points (x, y) such that (x − 1)2 + y2 = r2 is a circle of radius r around the point (1, 0).
flashcards.definitionZh: 二维几何图形，即一条线，由平面上距给定点（中心）距离相等的所有点组成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 满足 (x − 1)2 + y2 = r2 的所有点 (x, y) 的集合是围绕点 (1, 0) 的半径为 r 的圆。

flashcards.definition: So as to form a circle or trace a circular path, or approximation thereof.
flashcards.example: High above, vultures circled around.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以便形成一个圆或追踪一个圆形路径，或其近似。
flashcards.exampleZh: 高处，秃鹫盘旋。

flashcards.definition: The act of shaking or being shaken; tremulous or back-and-forth motion.
flashcards.example: She replied in the negative, with a shake of her head.
flashcards.definitionZh: 摇动或被摇动的行为；颤抖或前后运动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她摇摇头，给出否定的回答。

flashcards.definition: A nomination.
flashcards.example: For the fifth time in her career she received a Grammy nod, she has yet to win the award.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提名。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是她职业生涯中第五次获得格莱美奖，但她尚未赢得该奖项。

flashcards.definition: To manage, control, steer.
flashcards.example: to direct the affairs of a nation or the movements of an army
flashcards.definitionZh: 管理、控制、引导。
flashcards.exampleZh: 指挥国家事务或军队行动

flashcards.definition: In a direct manner; in a straight line or course.
flashcards.example: He drove directly to the office, and didn't stop off at the petrol station.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以直接的方式；沿直线或路线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他直接开车去办公室，没有在加油站停车。

flashcards.definition: A process by which a task is completed; a way of doing something (followed by the adposition of, to or for before the purpose of the process):
flashcards.example: If one method doesn't work, you should ask a friend to help you.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完成任务的过程；做某事的一种方式（在过程的目的之前附加、到或为了）：
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果一种方法不起作用，你应该请朋友来帮助你。

flashcards.definition: The person who chases and tries to catch the other players in the playground game of tag.
flashcards.example: In the next game, Adam and Tom will be it…
flashcards.definitionZh: 在操场上的捉人游戏中追逐并试图抓住其他玩家的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在下一场比赛中，亚当和汤姆将是……

flashcards.definition: An act of thinking; consideration (of something).
flashcards.example: I'll have a think about that and let you know.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种思考的行为；考虑（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我会考虑一下并告诉你。

flashcards.definition: To a greater degree or extent.
flashcards.example: I could no more climb that than fly!
flashcards.definitionZh: 在更大的程度上或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我无法攀爬它，就像无法飞翔一样！

flashcards.definition: A higher-pitched or stronger articulation of a particular syllable of a word or phrase in order to distinguish it from the others or to emphasize it.
flashcards.example: In the word "careful", the accent is placed on the first syllable.
flashcards.definitionZh: 单词或短语的特定音节的更高音调或更强烈的发音，以便将其与其他音节区分开来或强调它。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在“careful”这个词中，重音放在第一个音节上。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: A group or swarm, especially suspended above the ground or flying.
flashcards.example: He opened the door and was greeted by a cloud of bats.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一群或一群，尤其是悬浮在地面以上或飞行的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他打开门，迎接他的是一群蝙蝠。

flashcards.definition: To memorize; to put something into memory.
flashcards.example: Please remember this formula!
flashcards.definitionZh: 去记忆；将某些东西放入内存中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请记住这个公式！

flashcards.definition: To lose remembrance of.
flashcards.example: I have forgotten most of the things I learned in school.
flashcards.definitionZh: 失去对的记忆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经忘记了大部分在学校学到的东西。

flashcards.definition: In close approximation; almost, virtually.
flashcards.example: He left a nearly full beer on the bar.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常接近；几乎，实际上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在吧台上留下了几乎满满的啤酒。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word wasn't was not.
flashcards.example: This is the word wasn't was not.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这个词的意思不是不是。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“不是”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word weren't were not.
flashcards.example: This is the word weren't were not.
flashcards.definitionZh: “不是”这个词的意思是“不是”。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“不是不是”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country.
flashcards.example: There are several species of wild flowers growing in this field.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有林地、城市和城镇的土地区域；野外。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这片田野里生长着多种野花。

flashcards.definition: (of a quantity, etc.) To become larger or greater.
flashcards.example: His rage only increased when I told him of the lost money.
flashcards.definitionZh: （数量等）变得更大或更大。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我告诉他钱丢了的事时，他的怒火只增不减。

flashcards.definition: A contest, a struggle.
flashcards.example: the battle of life
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场较量，一场斗争。
flashcards.exampleZh: 生命之战

flashcards.definition: Organized, large-scale, armed conflict between countries or between national, ethnic, or other sizeable groups, usually involving the engagement of military forces.
flashcards.example: The war was largely between Sunni and Shia militants.
flashcards.definitionZh: 国家之间或民族、种族或其他较大群体之间有组织的大规模武装冲突，通常涉及军事力量的参与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 战争主要是逊尼派和什叶派武装分子之间的战争。

flashcards.definition: To go over, or jump over.
flashcards.example: He overed the fence in good style.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过去，或者跳过。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他以良好的方式越过栅栏。

flashcards.definition: The establishment of communication (with).
flashcards.example: I haven't been in contact with her for years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建立通讯（与）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经很多年没有和她联系了。

flashcards.definition: A person or thing toward which an emotion is directed.
flashcards.example: Mary Jane had been the object of Peter's affection for years.
flashcards.definitionZh: 情感所指向的人或事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 玛丽·简多年来一直是彼得喜爱的对象。

flashcards.definition: An image of an object that is formed in the mind or recalled by the memory.
flashcards.example: The mere idea of you is enough to excite me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在头脑中形成或由记忆回忆起的物体的图像。
flashcards.exampleZh: 仅仅想到你就足以让我兴奋。

flashcards.definition: Frequently, many times.
flashcards.example: I often walk to work when the weather is nice.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经常，很多次。
flashcards.exampleZh: 天气好的时候我经常步行去上班。

flashcards.definition: Not occurring at a regular interval; seldom; not often.
flashcards.example: Rarely do you ever find an eagle this far up the river.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不定期发生；很少;不经常。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你很少能在河上游这么远的地方找到一只鹰。

flashcards.definition: A region where a particular action takes place; a specific field of action, usually with reference to war.
flashcards.example: His grandfather was in the Pacific theater during the war.
flashcards.definitionZh: 发生特定动作的区域；特定的行动领域，通常与战争有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 战争期间，他的祖父在太平洋战区。

flashcards.definition: To grasp a concept fully and thoroughly, especially (of words, statements, art, etc.) to be aware of the meaning of and (of people) to be aware of the intent of.
flashcards.example: I'm sorry. I don't understand.
flashcards.definitionZh: 充分彻底地掌握一个概念，尤其是（词语、陈述、艺术等）意识到其含义和（人）意识到其意图。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对不起。我不明白。

flashcards.definition: (manner) without approximation; precisely.
flashcards.example: He divided the coins exactly in half.
flashcards.definitionZh: （方式）没有近似；恰恰。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他把这些硬币正好分成两半。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin-script letter I.
flashcards.example: the position of an i-dot (the dot of an i)
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 I 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: i-dot 的位置（i 的点）

flashcards.definition: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station.
flashcards.example: They agreed to meet at the bus stop.
flashcards.definitionZh: 公共汽车、有轨电车或火车停下来让乘客上下车的（通常有标记的）地方，通常比车站小。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们约定在公交车站见面。

flashcards.definition: To communicate, usually by means of speech.
flashcards.example: Although I don't speak Chinese I managed to talk with the villagers using signs and gestures.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沟通，通常是通过言语的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然我不会说中文，但我还是用手势和手势与村民交谈。

flashcards.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character
flashcards.example: His low voice allowed him to become a bass in the choir.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用嘴发出的声音，尤其是人类在言语或歌曲中发出的声音；发出的声音被认为具有某种特殊的品质或特征
flashcards.exampleZh: 他低沉的声音使他成为合唱团的贝斯手。

flashcards.definition: Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of (that).
flashcards.example: He told me not to do it. I, however, did it anyway. / I did it anyway, however. / (sometimes proscribed:) However, I did it anyway.
flashcards.definitionZh: 尽管如此;然而，仍然；尽管（那样）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他告诉我不要这样做。然而我还是这么做了。 / 然而我还是这么做了。 /（有时被禁止：）但是，我还是这么做了。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word diddo.
flashcards.example: This is the word diddo.
flashcards.definitionZh: diddo 这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是迪多这个词。

flashcards.definition: A blank document or template to be filled in by the user.
flashcards.example: To apply for the position, complete the application form.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由用户填写的空白文档或模板。
flashcards.exampleZh: 要申请该职位，请填写申请表。

flashcards.definition: A frequent, routine visitor to an establishment.
flashcards.example: Bartenders usually know their regulars by name.
flashcards.definitionZh: 经常光顾某个机构的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 调酒师通常都知道常客的名字。

flashcards.definition: The means by which something is accomplished.
flashcards.example: I am not interested in the why, but in the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完成某事的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对“为什么”不感兴趣，而对“如何”感兴趣。

flashcards.definition: A perennial woody plant, not exactly defined, but differentiated from a shrub by its larger size (typically over a few meters in height) or growth habit, usually having a single (or few) main axis or trunk unbranched for some distance above the ground and a head of branches and foliage.
flashcards.example: Birds have a nest in a tree in the garden.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种多年生木本植物，没有确切的定义，但与灌木的区别在于其较大的尺寸（通常高度超过几米）或生长习性，通常具有单个（或几个）主轴或树干，在地面上方一定距离处不分枝，并且具有树枝和叶子的头部。
flashcards.exampleZh: 鸟儿在花园里的树上筑巢。

flashcards.definition: (usually in combination) A location used for an industrial purpose, having many similar structures
flashcards.example: antenna farm
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常组合）用于工业目的的地点，具有许多相似的结构
flashcards.exampleZh: 天线场

flashcards.definition: Any of several intelligent mammalian species of the genus Sus, having cloven hooves, bristles and a nose adapted for digging; especially the domesticated animal Sus scrofa.
flashcards.example: The man kept a pen with two pigs that he fed from carrots to cabbage.
flashcards.definitionZh: 猪属的几种聪明哺乳动物中的一种，有偶蹄、刚毛和适于挖掘的鼻子；尤其是家养动物野猪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该男子饲养着两只猪，用胡萝卜和卷心菜喂猪。

flashcards.definition: (properly) An adult female of the species Bos taurus, especially one that has calved.
flashcards.example: This is the word COW.
flashcards.definitionZh: （正确）牛属的成年雌性，尤其是已经产犊的雌性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是牛这个词。

flashcards.definition: A woolly ruminant of the genus Ovis.
flashcards.example: This is the word SHEEP.
flashcards.definitionZh: 绵羊属的一种长毛反刍动物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“羊”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Cowardly.
flashcards.example: Why do you refuse to fight? Huh, I guess you're just too chicken.
flashcards.definitionZh: 胆小。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你为什么拒绝战斗？呵呵，我觉得你太胆小了。

flashcards.definition: Any of several animals related to Equus ferus caballus.
flashcards.example: This is the word HORSE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与马属（Equus ferus caballus）有关的几种动物中的任何一种。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“马”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A state of tranquility, quiet, and harmony; absence of violence. For instance, a state free from civil disturbance.
flashcards.example: Our lounge strives to maintain an environment of peace for the comfort of our customers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种安宁、安静、和谐的状态；没有暴力。例如，一个没有内乱的国家。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的休息室致力于维持一个安静的环境，让顾客感到舒适。

flashcards.definition: To ascertain the quantity of a unit of material via calculated comparison with respect to a standard.
flashcards.example: We measured the temperature with a thermometer.   You should measure the angle with a spirit level.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过与标准的计算比较来确定单位材料的数量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们用温度计测量了温度。   您应该用水平仪测量角度。

flashcards.definition: Required, essential, whether logically inescapable or needed in order to achieve a desired result or avoid some penalty.
flashcards.example: Although I wished to think that all was false, it was yet necessary that I, who thus thought, must in some sense exist.
flashcards.definitionZh: 必需的、必要的，无论是逻辑上不可避免的还是为了达到预期结果或避免某些惩罚而需要的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然我希望认为一切都是假的，但我这样认为的人在某种意义上必须存在。

flashcards.definition: Money given in return for work; salary or wages.
flashcards.example: Many employers have rules designed to keep employees from comparing their pays.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为工作回报而给予的金钱；工资或工资。
flashcards.exampleZh: 许多雇主都有旨在阻止员工比较工资的规定。

flashcards.definition: Money in the form of notes/bills and coins, as opposed to cheques/checks or electronic transactions.
flashcards.example: After you bounced those checks last time, they want to be paid in cash.
flashcards.definitionZh: 纸币/票据和硬币形式的货币，而不是支票/支票或电子交易。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在您上次退回这些支票后，他们希望以现金支付。

flashcards.definition: Recognition and respect.
flashcards.example: He arrived five minutes late, but to his credit he did work an extra ten minutes at the end of his shift.
flashcards.definitionZh: 认可和尊重。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他迟到了五分钟，但值得赞扬的是，他在轮班结束时确实多工作了十分钟。

flashcards.definition: A male or female attendant who serves customers at their tables in a restaurant, café or similar.
flashcards.example: Waiter! There's a fly in my soup.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在餐厅、咖啡馆或类似场所为顾客提供服务的男性或女性服务员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 服务员！我的汤里有一只苍蝇。

flashcards.definition: A female attendant who serves customers in a restaurant, café, or similar.
flashcards.example: This is the word WAITRESS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在餐馆、咖啡馆或类似场所为顾客提供服务的女服务员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是WAITRESS这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word wasnt.
flashcards.example: This is the word wasnt.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这个词的意思不是。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个词不是。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word werent.
flashcards.example: This is the word werent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这个词的意思不是。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“werent”这个词。

flashcards.definition: In company; together.
flashcards.example: John played the piano and everyone sang along.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在公司；一起。
flashcards.exampleZh: 约翰弹钢琴，每个人都跟着唱。

flashcards.definition: A method or manner of doing something; a mannerism.
flashcards.example: You're going about it the wrong way.  He's known for his quirky ways.  I don't like the way she looks at me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做某事的方法或方式；一种矫揉造作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你的做法是错误的。  他以古怪的行事方式而闻名。  我不喜欢她看我的方式。

flashcards.definition: The means by which something is accomplished.
flashcards.example: I am not interested in the why, but in the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完成某事的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对“为什么”不感兴趣，而对“如何”感兴趣。

flashcards.definition: The state of being free from physical or psychological disease, illness, or malfunction; wellness.
flashcards.example: Her mental health is really affected by stressful environments.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有身体或心理疾病、疾病或机能障碍的状态；健康。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的心理健康确实受到压力环境的影响。

flashcards.definition: Enjoying health and vigor of body, mind, or spirit: well.
flashcards.example: He was father to three healthy kids.
flashcards.definitionZh: 享受身体、思想或精神的健康和活力：好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他是三个健康孩子的父亲。

flashcards.definition: Characterized by, or conducive to poor health
flashcards.example: The villagers lived in unhealthy surroundings.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以健康状况不佳为特征或导致健康状况不佳
flashcards.exampleZh: 村民生活环境恶劣。

flashcards.definition: Newly produced or obtained; recent.
flashcards.example: He followed the fresh hoofprints to find the deer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 新生产或获得的；最近的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他顺着新鲜的蹄印找到了鹿。

flashcards.definition: A damaged area of a surface where a small piece has been broken off.
flashcards.example: This cup has a chip in it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 表面受损区域，其中一小块已折断。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个杯子里有一个芯片。

flashcards.definition: A food made primarily of a mixture of raw or cold ingredients, typically vegetables, usually served with a dressing such as vinegar or mayonnaise.
flashcards.example: This is the word SALAD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主要由生的或冷的成分（通常是蔬菜）的混合物制成的食物，通常与醋或蛋黄酱等调味品一起食用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是沙拉这个词。

flashcards.definition: To harmonize in opinion, statement, or action; to be in unison or concord; to be or become united or consistent; to concur.
flashcards.example: all parties agree in the expediency of the law.
flashcards.definitionZh: 协调意见、声明或行动；一致或一致；变得团结或一致；同意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 各方均在法律允许的范围内达成一致。

flashcards.definition: An additional enemy that joins a fight after the primary target.
flashcards.example: When the player has fought the boss for one minute, two adds will arrive from the back and must be dealt with.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在主要目标之后加入战斗的额外敌人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当玩家与boss战斗一分钟后，会有两个小怪从后面到达，必须处理。

flashcards.definition: An instance of propelling oneself upwards.
flashcards.example: The boy took a skip and a jump down the lane.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个推动自己向上的例子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 男孩沿着小巷一蹦一跳。

flashcards.definition: The point where two converging lines meet; an angle, either external or internal.
flashcards.example: The corners of the wire mesh were reinforced with little blobs of solder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两条交汇线的交点；一个角，可以是外角，也可以是内角。
flashcards.exampleZh: 金属丝网的角上用小焊点加固。

flashcards.definition: A water-borne vessel generally larger than a boat.
flashcards.example: This is the word SHIP.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常比船大的水上船只。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是船这个词。

flashcards.definition: A vehicle, utensil, or dish somewhat resembling a boat in shape.
flashcards.example: a stone boat;  a gravy boat
flashcards.definitionZh: 形状有点像船的车辆、器具或盘子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 石船；  一个肉汁船

flashcards.definition: Something or someone that doesn't quite make it.
flashcards.example: In all the submissions, they found four papers that were clearly worth publishing and another dozen almosts.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一些没能成功的人或事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在所有提交的材料中，他们发现四篇论文显然值得发表，另外十几篇论文几乎值得发表。

flashcards.definition: A department of a newspaper tasked with covering a particular geographical region or aspect of the news.
flashcards.example: city desk
flashcards.definitionZh: 报纸的一个部门，负责报道特定地理区域或新闻的某个方面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 城市服务台

flashcards.definition: A position of responsibility.
flashcards.example: When the office of Secretary of State is vacant, its duties fall upon an official within the department.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个有责任的岗位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当国务卿职位空缺时，其职责由部门内的一名官员承担。

flashcards.definition: A task.
flashcards.example: A job half done is hardly done at all.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一项任务。
flashcards.exampleZh: 半途而废的工作根本就不算完成。

flashcards.definition: The beginning of an activity.
flashcards.example: The movie was entertaining from start to finish.
flashcards.definitionZh: 活动的开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这部电影从头到尾都很有趣。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: The anniversary of the day on which someone is born.
flashcards.example: This is the word BIRTHDAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某人出生的周年纪念日。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“生日”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The word "hi" used as a greeting.
flashcards.example: I didn't even get a hi.
flashcards.wordZh: 嗨表示问候或用以唤起注意
flashcards.definitionZh: “嗨”一词用作问候语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我什至没有打个招呼。

flashcards.definition: A meeting.
flashcards.example: OK, let's arrange a meet with Tyler and ask him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一次会议。
flashcards.exampleZh: 好的，我们安排一次与泰勒的会面并询问他的情况。

flashcards.definition: Respectable; virtuous.
flashcards.example: What is a nice person like you doing in a place like this?
flashcards.definitionZh: 可敬;有道德的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 像你这样的好人在这种地方做什么？

flashcards.definition: The means by which something is accomplished.
flashcards.example: I am not interested in the why, but in the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完成某事的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对“为什么”不感兴趣，而对“如何”感兴趣。

flashcards.definition: (ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
flashcards.example: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.
flashcards.definitionZh: （双及物）前往某人/某处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 服务员，请给我一杯单一麦芽威士忌。

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: (heading) To the greatest extent or degree; completely, entirely.
flashcards.example: This is the word QUITE.
flashcards.definitionZh: （标题）最大范围或程度；完全地，完全地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“相当”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To hit (the ball) completely cleanly and accurately
flashcards.example: Tiger Woods pured his first drive straight down the middle of the fairway.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全干净、准确地击球
flashcards.exampleZh: 泰格·伍兹第一次开球直接击中球道中部。

flashcards.definition: To defile; to pollute
flashcards.example: This is the word IMPURE PURE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 玷污；污染
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“不纯”这个词。

flashcards.definition: An oath or affirmation; a vow
flashcards.example: if I make a promise, I always stick to it;  he broke his promise
flashcards.definitionZh: 宣誓或誓言；一个誓言
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果我做出了承诺，我就一定会遵守；  他违背了他的诺言

flashcards.definition: Well-mannered, civilized.
flashcards.example: It's not polite to use a mobile phone in a restaurant.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有礼貌，文明。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在餐厅使用手机是不礼貌的。

flashcards.definition: Not polite; not of polished manners; wanting in good manners.
flashcards.example: This is the word IMPOLITE POLITE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不礼貌；没有优雅的举止；想要有礼貌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“IMPOLITE POLITE”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Fully grown.
flashcards.example: an adult human, animal, or plant
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全长大了。
flashcards.exampleZh: 成年人、动物或植物

flashcards.definition: A person between 13 and 19 years of age; an adolescent.
flashcards.example: This is the word TEENAGER.
flashcards.definitionZh: 13 岁至 19 岁之间的人；一个青少年。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“青少年”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Explanation designed to avoid or alleviate guilt or negative judgment; a plea offered in extenuation of a fault.
flashcards.example: Tell me why you were late – and I don't want to hear any excuses!
flashcards.definitionZh: 旨在避免或减轻内疚或负面判断的解释；为减轻过失而提出的抗辩。
flashcards.exampleZh: 告诉我你迟到的原因——我不想听到任何借口！

flashcards.definition: To defile; to pollute
flashcards.example: This is the word IMPURE PURE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 玷污；污染
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“不纯”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Not polite; not of polished manners; wanting in good manners.
flashcards.example: This is the word IMPOLITE POLITE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不礼貌；没有优雅的举止；想要有礼貌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“IMPOLITE POLITE”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To perform; to execute.
flashcards.example: All you ever do is surf the Internet. What will you do this afternoon?
flashcards.definitionZh: 执行；执行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您所做的就是上网冲浪。今天下午你要做什么？
